title: Raku & Alternative Firings with Judi Harwood
commitment: Eight sessions: four instruction sessions plus firing preparation, then three outdoor firing sessions
how_to_join: Register via the link on the class page
summary: Eight-session specialty class exploring raku and alternative firing techniques (saggar, horsehair, obvara) for seasoned beginners through advanced potters, with four instruction sessions plus three outdoor firing days.
source_quote: Fire up your creativity! Raku & Alternative Firings with Judi Harwood on Fridays (October 2–December 4, 2026)
evidence_sentence: The class description states it explores 'saggar, horsehair, obvara, and glazed raku' in outdoor firings.
evidence_quote: Explore dramatic surfaces and the unpredictable beauty of saggar, horsehair, obvara, and glazed raku in this eight-session specialty class.
